basis.method: damped straight-line trend of weekly demand (orders plus turned away), times a market-context factor; range = 1.28 x weekly scatter x 2

note: An estimate from recent weeks, not a forecast. The market-context effect is an assumption, not a measured fact.
text: For 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-08 we project 32 to 48 orders, most likely about 40. This is an estimate from your recent weeks, not a forecast. It uses your last 8 weeks (trend -1.51 a week) and a context factor of 1 from f1_calendar. Demand windows in that period: United States Grand Prix (2026-10-23 to 2026-10-25), Mexico City Grand Prix (2026-10-30 to 2026-11-01), Brazilian Grand Prix (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-08). The bottleneck that most limits it is reach; this week's actions target it.
